main_text.head: Exempla morborum formalium. CAPVT VII.
main_text.p: § 1. Orat Fernelius, abfque exem-plis nihil rite adftrui poffe, Propterea accingit fe operi quidem: ve-rum tam frigide ftat, ut praeftiterit filuif-fe. Et quia fequor Montanum, quid cap, 17.initio frigidius dici poffit,quam mor-bos occultos fubdiuidi in manifeftos & occultos? Nec locus eft tergiuerfationi, fi quis vel verba ipfius authoris intuea-tur,vel paraphrafin Montani, Non minus frigidum eft, Morbos iftos novos effe ex caufis direćto fibi oppofitis, cum & fine putredine,eaq; vel fimplici,vel profunda.

§ 2. Poft ulcera, cap.18. funt morbi formales ex Putredine. Vbi fi queras, Cum putrefcere poffint partes tres Hip-pocrati dićte, dequibus loquatur? De omnibus, dicet tibi Mont. adducto loco ex l. de Abd. Cui aflertioni quia objici poterat, Intemperies indigent fimplici alteratione, ad putredines miftam ... ex alteratione & vacuatione, Dicam primo loco, Putredines iftas non effe morbos: fed caufas, Secundo,Reducitur pfeudophilofophema illud, in quo con-funduntur motus praevii ad terminum cum.

page.notes: Marginal and left-edge letters are partly cut off; the text has several doubtful readings (e.g. the Greek-looking reference "ǂ" and the signature line "cum" at foot). Marginal side text from the left neighbouring page is not transcribed.
